Shared functions (`randomize_interaction_matrix`, `run_paired_sims`, and the
project's gear/selectivity helpers) live in `Ess_Fishmip_data/Useful_functions.R`:
single source of truth, also used by the standalone `run_ensemble_sims.R`
generator. This must be loaded BEFORE any `setParams()`-triggering call, because
`gaussian_sizeweight` is the `sel_func` for the Seals gear rows.
```{r load-shared-functions}
source("Ess_Fishmip_data/Useful_functions.R")

# Gaussian prey size-selectivity for seals (used by mizer internally).
# Defined here only as a fallback if Useful_functions.R did not supply it.
if (!exists("gaussian_sizeweight")) {
  gaussian_sizeweight <- function(w, species_params, w_opt, sigma, ...) {
    exp(-0.5 * ((log(w) - log(w_opt)) / sigma)^2)
  }
}
```

# Load params from base mizer calibration

Thermal ranges come from FishBase, with documented departures below.
DFO. 2014. Assessment of Spiny Dogfish in the Northwest Atlantic. DFO Can. Sci.
Advis. Sec. Sci. Advis. Rep. 2014/055.

```{r load-params}
# Use stage 1 because stage 2 is not stable
params <- readRDS("Ess_Fishmip_data/params_stage1_steady.RDS")
thermal_data <- read.csv("Ess_Fishmip_data/species_params_with_temp.csv")

# thermal_data rows are assumed to align positionally with species_params.
# Assert it: a silent reorder would assign thermal limits to the wrong species.
stopifnot(identical(as.character(thermal_data$Common_Name),
                    as.character(params@species_params$species)))
params@species_params$temp_min <- thermal_data$TempPrefMin
params@species_params$temp_max <- thermal_data$TempPrefMax

# ---- Documented departures from the FishBase estimate() baseline -----------
# FishBase TempPrefMin/Max come from estimate(), the AquaMaps-derived envelope:
# an occurrence (realised-niche) range, not physiological limits. therMizer uses
# these as a thermal PERFORMANCE curve, so where the envelope disagrees with
# where the species actually lives on this shelf, the scaling collapses to zero.
set_temp <- function(p, sp, tmin, tmax) {
  i <- which(p@species_params$species == sp)
  stopifnot(length(i) == 1)
  p@species_params$temp_min[i] <- tmin
  p@species_params$temp_max[i] <- tmax
  p
}

# Capelin and Red Hake were proxy-filled in 00.Params_extraction.R (herring and
# white hake proxies). FishBase now has real values; uncomment to use them.
#params <- set_temp(params, "Capelin",  0.3,  7.1)   # was 0.5-11.2 (herring proxy)
#params <- set_temp(params, "Red Hake", 1.6, 11.1)   # was 1.2-7.8  (white hake proxy)

# Spiny Dogfish: the only species with exactly ZERO scaling at the reference
# state (weighted 100% to r50to150 at 4.03 C while FishBase temp_min = 4.2).
# FishBase stocks() is worse (7.0-15.0), so use DFO (2014).
params <- set_temp(params, "Spiny Dogfish", 0, 12)

# Thorny Skate: AquaMaps gives -0.8 to 5.0 (mean 1.0 C), the Arctic core rather
# than the tolerance. That puts the whole shallow stratum (6.66 C) outside the
# range, contradicting the survey (8 strata, 18.4% of stratum 447), and the deep
# realm (4.86 C by 2015-24) ends up within 0.14 C of tmax, so performance more
# than halves (0.723 -> 0.317) and hits zero past 5.0 C. That is an artefact of
# the envelope, not a thermal response. stocks() gives -1.3 to 14.0 ("boreal").
params <- set_temp(params, "Thorny Skate", -1.3, 14.0)   # was -0.8-5.0

stopifnot(all(params@species_params$temp_max > params@species_params$temp_min))
```

### Setting up the resource
```{r resource}
# Dynamic runs use the full 1861-2010 forcing. The 1978-81 window is only the
# REFERENCE state, used below for sanity checks (Paper 1's Stage-1 reference,
# chosen by a rolling-window stationarity screen of survey biomass).
reference_years <- 1978:1981

spectra_file <- "Ess_Fishmip_data/GFDL_resource_spectra.dat"
isimip_plankton <- as.matrix(read.table(spectra_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE))
# 04 now writes year row names; fall back to counting from 1861 if absent
if (is.null(rownames(isimip_plankton)) ||
    anyNA(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rownames(isimip_plankton))))) {
  rownames(isimip_plankton) <- 1861:(1861 + nrow(isimip_plankton) - 1)
}
stopifnot(all(as.character(reference_years) %in% rownames(isimip_plankton)))
stopifnot(ncol(isimip_plankton) == length(params@w_full))   # 04 must match this base

sizes <- names(params@initial_n_pp)

# Diagnostic: reference-period resource (log10 numbers per bin, as 04 writes it)
# vs Paper 1's calibrated resource. Not used by the dynamic run.
n_pp_ref <- colMeans(isimip_plankton[as.character(reference_years), , drop = FALSE])
ok_pp <- params@initial_n_pp > 0
lvl <- median((n_pp_ref - log10(params@dw_full))[ok_pp] -
              log10(params@initial_n_pp[ok_pp]))
message("resource reference ", min(reference_years), "-", max(reference_years),
        " mean vs Paper 1 calibrated resource, median: ",
        sprintf("%+.4f log10 (x%.3g)", lvl, 10^lvl))
```

### Setting up temperature-related information
```{r temperature}
ocean_temp_raw <- read.csv("Ess_Fishmip_data/Temp_by_depth_spin.csv", header = TRUE)
rownames(ocean_temp_raw) <- as.character(ocean_temp_raw$year)
ocean_temp_all <- as.matrix(ocean_temp_raw[, setdiff(names(ocean_temp_raw), "year")])
stopifnot(all(as.character(reference_years) %in% rownames(ocean_temp_all)))

temp_ref <- colMeans(ocean_temp_all[as.character(reference_years), , drop = FALSE])
message("temperature reference: ",
        paste(sprintf("%s %.2f C", names(temp_ref), temp_ref), collapse = ", "))

# Sanity check: no species should sit outside its thermal range in EVERY realm
# at the reference state (that gives zero scaling, i.e. a hard extinction rather
# than a gradient). Checks that at least one realm's reference temperature lies
# strictly inside (temp_min, temp_max) for each species.
in_range <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(params@species_params)), function(i) {
  any(temp_ref > params@species_params$temp_min[i] &
      temp_ref < params@species_params$temp_max[i])
}, logical(1))
stopifnot(all(in_range))
```

```{r warnings-note, include=FALSE}
# TWO WARNINGS FROM upgradeTherParams / projection ARE EXPECTED AND BENIGN.
#
# 1. "The dimnames of the second dimension of `n_pp_array` are not the same as
#    the ones in `w_full` ... have been replaced by `w_full`" (once). A therMizer
#    bug: it compares a CHARACTER dimnames vector against a NUMERIC one, so the
#    check is always FALSE. therMizer then assigns correct numeric-parseable
#    names itself, which plankton_forcing() needs for the w_pp_cutoff test.
#
# 2. "There is no `balance_plankton_forcing()` function, so the resource
#    capacity could not be rebalanced". therMizer supplies no balancing function
#    for its resource dynamics. Harmless for the dynamic runs here.
```

```{r migration-exposure}
tmp_env <- new.env()
load("Ess_Fishmip_data/GFDL_ESS_vertical_migration_array.Rdata", envir = tmp_env)
vertical_migration_array <- tmp_env$vertical_migration_array
```

# Build the time-varying (dynamic) params

A steady state under time-varying forcing does not exist (the forcing moves every
year, so the solver cannot converge). Steady-state calibration needs
constant-in-time inputs and belongs in the separate calibration script. This file
runs the DYNAMICS with `project()`.

```{r dynamic-params}
params <- validParams(params)

# Both must cover the same years, in the same order
stopifnot(nrow(ocean_temp_all) == nrow(isimip_plankton),          # 150 each
          identical(rownames(ocean_temp_all), rownames(isimip_plankton)))

# n_pp_array: years x size bins
n_pp_array_dyn <- isimip_plankton
dimnames(n_pp_array_dyn) <- list(time = rownames(isimip_plankton), w = sizes)

params_dyn <- upgradeTherParams(params,
                  ocean_temp = ocean_temp_all,           # 150 x 2
                  n_pp_array = n_pp_array_dyn,           # 150 x 211
                  vertical_migration_array = vertical_migration_array,
                  exposure_array = exposure_array,
                  aerobic_effect = TRUE,
                  metabolism_effect = TRUE)
```

## Effort (factual run)

```{r effort}
eff <- read.csv("Ess_Fishmip_data/Effort_spin_1861_2010.csv", check.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(eff) == 150)

eff <- eff[, setdiff(names(eff), "year")]          # drop year by name, not position
effort_factual <- as.matrix(eff)
rownames(effort_factual) <- 1861:2010

# # ---- Scenario A: no effort (all gears, including seals, set to 0) ----
# no_effort <- effort_factual
# no_effort[] <- 0

# Reference factual run (no randomisation). Uses params_dyn so it has the same
# thermal and plankton forcing as the randomised runs; otherwise the relative
# plot would compare thermal vs non-thermal rather than random vs base web.
sim0 <- project(params_dyn, effort = effort_factual)

# Quick test: one randomised-web run
rand_params <- randomize_interaction_matrix(params_dyn)
sim1 <- project(rand_params, effort = effort_factual)
plot(sim1, time_range = 1961:2010)
plotBiomassRelative(sim1, sim0)
```

## Ensemble over randomised food webs (factual only)

Structural-uncertainty robustness test: `randomize_interaction_matrix()` multiplies
each existing interaction-matrix entry and each seal catchability by lognormal
noise (SD = `sd_web`), scaling existing link strengths while keeping topology
(zeros stay zero). Each member is projected from the calibrated state (a transient
hindcast, not equilibrium). `sd_web = 0.1` (~10% CV per link) is the primary
setting; 0.2 is a stronger stress test.

```{r}
eff <- read.csv("Ess_Fishmip_data/Effort_spin_1861_2010.csv", check.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(eff) == 150)

eff <- eff[, setdiff(names(eff), "year")]          # drop year by name, not position
effort_factual <- as.matrix(eff)
rownames(effort_factual) <- 1861:2010

effort_no_fishing <- effort_factual
effort_no_fishing[, colnames(effort_no_fishing) != "Seals"] <- 0   # all gears 0 except Seals
write.csv(effort_no_fishing,"Ess_Thermizer_data/effort_no_fishing.csv", row.names = FALSE)
effort_counter<- effort_no_fishing

```


## Read in sims with and without sims (we are working with the one with seals)
```{r}
# ── ENSEMBLE: factual vs counterfactual over randomised food webs ─────────────
# Structural-uncertainty robustness test: randomize_interaction_matrix() multiplies each
# existing interaction-matrix entry AND each seal catchability by lognormal noise (SD =
# sd_web) - scaling existing link STRENGTHS (topology preserved, zeros stay zero) and
# perturbing seal predation the same way. Projected from the calibrated 1978 state (a
# transient hindcast, not equilibrium). PAIRED: same web under both scenarios, so the
# per-web difference isolates the seal effect and cancels the perturbation drift =>
# base conclusions on the paired difference / fraction of webs, not the ribbon spread.
# sd_web = 0.1 = primary (~10% CV/link, realistic); 0.2 = stronger stress test (below).
n_sims <- 10; sd_web <- 0.1

# CACHE GUARD: the n=1000 paired ensemble is the expensive step (~15 min). Run it
# ONCE; every later knit reads the saved RDS in seconds. To regenerate after changing
# `params`, set force_resim <- TRUE before this chunk (or delete the two RDS files).
cache_f <- "Ess_Fishmip_data/sims_with_fishing.RDS"   # seal increase (factual)
cache_c <- "Ess_Fishmip_data/sims_with_no_fishing.RDS"   # seals constant (counterfactual)
if (file.exists(cache_f) && file.exists(cache_c) && !exists("force_resim")) {
  sims_factual <- readRDS(cache_f)
  sims_counter <- readRDS(cache_c)
  cat(sprintf("Loaded cached ensemble: %d paired members (set force_resim<-TRUE to rerun)\n",
              length(sims_factual)))
} else {
  paired <- run_paired_sims(params_dyn, n_sims = n_sims, sd = sd_web,
                            effort_factual = effort_factual,
                            effort_counter = effort_counter, seed = 42)
  sims_with_fishing <- paired$factual
  sims_with_no_fishing <- paired$counter

  # Keep only COMPLETE pairs (drop index i if either scenario failed) so the two lists
  # stay aligned & indexable: factual[[k]] and counter[[k]] are the SAME web.
  ok <- which(!vapply(sims_with_fishing, is.null, logical(1)) &
              !vapply(sims_with_no_fishing, is.null, logical(1)))
  sims_with_fishing <- sims_with_fishing[ok]; sims_with_no_fishing <- sims_with_no_fishing[ok]
  cat(sprintf("Kept %d / %d complete paired ensemble members\n", length(ok), n_sims))

  # Save sim outputs (complete-pair filtered) for downstream use (04_Indicators)
  saveRDS(sims_with_fishing, cache_f)
  saveRDS(sims_with_no_fishing, cache_c)
}

# Aliases for the downstream figure code (scen2 = factual/with seal increase;
# scen1 = counterfactual/no seal increase) — now PAIRED by index
#sims_scen2 <- sims_factual
#sims_scen1 <- sims_counter


# Save sim outputs (complete-pair filtered) for downstream use (04_Indicators)
saveRDS(sims_with_fishing, "Ess_Fishmip_data/sims_with_fishing.RDS")   # seal increase (factual)
saveRDS(sims_with_no_fishing, "Ess_Fishmip_data/sims_with_no_fishing.RDS")   # seals constant (counterfactual)
sims_with_fishing <- readRDS("Ess_Fishmip_data/sims_with_fishing.RDS")
sims_with_no_fishing <- readRDS("Ess_Fishmip_data/sims_with_no_fishing.RDS")


# Check results from first simulation
plot(sims_with_fishing[[1]],time_range=c(1961:2010))

plotBiomassRelative(sims_with_fishing[[1]],sim0)
```

## Biomass Check
## Biomass Figures - make plot of obs and sims

REDO THIS USING DATA ABOVE:
Read in Abundance and Biomass at length from DFO RV Summer Survey (from DFO Maritimes region data team, 4VsW - see methods)
convert from KG to grams. 
Prior to calculation need to truncate the biomass at length by the same length cut_off used in the model.
Rename columns
```{r}
# Recalculate total annual biomass from raw survey data, 4VsW strata (443-466)
# Replaces pre-processed DFO_Biomass_selected_species.csv for strata consistency
stat <- read.csv("Ess_Thermizer_data/LF_Biomass_Abund.csv")

# ── LOOKUP: RAW SURVEY NAME -> MODEL NAME ────────────────────────────────────
species_code_lookup <- c(
  "COD(ATLANTIC)"             = "Atlantic Cod",
  "HADDOCK"                   = "Haddock",
  "WHITE HAKE"                = "White Hake",
  "SILVER HAKE"               = "Silver Hake",
  "POLLOCK"                   = "Pollock",
  "REDFISH UNSEPARATED"       = "Redfish Unseparated",
  "AMERICAN PLAICE"           = "American Plaice",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER"       = "Yellowtail Flounder",
  "SPINY DOGFISH"             = "Spiny Dogfish",
  "HALIBUT(ATLANTIC)"         = "Atlantic Halibut",
  "SQUIRREL OR RED HAKE"      = "Red Hake",
  "MONKFISH,GOOSEFISH,ANGLER" = "Monkfish",
  "NORTHERN SAND LANCE"       = "Sand Lance",
  "WITCH FLOUNDER"            = "Witch Flounder",
  "HERRING(ATLANTIC)"         = "Atlantic Herring",
  "THORNY SKATE"              = "Thorny Skate",
  "WINTER SKATE"              = "Winter Skate",
  "LONGHORN SCULPIN"          = "Longhorn Sculpin",
  "CAPELIN"                   = "Capelin")
species_order <- c( "Atlantic Cod", "Haddock", "White Hake", "Red Hake", "Silver Hake",
                    "Pollock", "Redfish Unseparated","American Plaice", "Yellowtail Flounder",
                    "Witch Flounder", "Atlantic Herring","Capelin", "Thorny Skate", 
                    "Winter Skate", "Spiny Dogfish", "Monkfish", "Sand Lance",
                    "Longhorn Sculpin",  "Atlantic Halibut")

biomass_obs <- stat %>%
  mutate(strat_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(STRAT)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(strat_num), strat_num >= 443, strat_num <= 466,
         YEAR >= 1970, YEAR <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(species_name = species_code_lookup[COMMON_NAME]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_name)) %>%
  group_by(Year = YEAR, species_name) %>%
  summarise(biomass_g = sum(Biomass_Strata_KG, na.rm = TRUE) * 1e3, .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = species_name, values_from = biomass_g, values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(Year, any_of(species_order))
biomass_obs[is.na(biomass_obs)] <- 0

## ── FORAGE-FISH SURVEY CATCHABILITY ──────────────────────────────────────────
## The bottom-trawl survey under-represents the small pelagics for TWO distinct
## reasons, which the occurrence analysis (above) lets us separate:
##  - SIZE SELECTIVITY (a missing juvenile end): handled NOT by scaling but by the
##    occurrence-based lower cutoff + matchBiomasses over the comparable adult
##    range — mizer then ESTIMATES the unsampled small end self-consistently.
##  - WHOLE-POPULATION AVAILABILITY (off-bottom / sediment-burying): the survey
##    misses individuals of ALL sizes, so there is NO hidden size range for the
##    model to fill; this genuinely needs an explicit catchability multiplier.
## Occurrence evidence (fraction of years each 2-cm bin is caught):
##  - Atlantic Herring: adults 22-34 cm caught reliably, juveniles <16 cm missed
##    -> a real juvenile gap. We TESTED dropping the x50 (size-range matching the
##    adult window): it FAILED -- the unscaled adult target is ~50x too small for
##    herring to seed itself against web predation, so erepro -> Inf (>1) on the
##    first matchBiomasses iteration. CONCLUSION: herring's bottom-trawl deficit is
##    NOT only a juvenile size gap but also ADULT AVAILABILITY (pelagic/off-bottom)
##    -- the adult window is itself under-caught, so size-range matching can't
##    recover it. Restored to x50. The juvenile end is still extrapolated by mizer
##    below the cutoff; the x50 now stands for adult availability.
##  - Sand Lance (8-24 cm) & Capelin (10-16 cm): the survey samples nearly their
##    WHOLE size range, so under-representation is availability, not truncation ->
##    keep an explicit catchability multiplier (was x200; based approx. on
##    Harley et al. 2001 and Bundy et al.). TEST SENSITIVITY.
forage_catchability_mult <- c(
  `Atlantic Herring` = 50,   # adult availability (pelagic/off-bottom); x1 test -> erepro Inf
  `Sand Lance`       = 3000, # was 200; BOOSTED so sand lance is the dominant forage & main
                             # seal prey (Bowen 81%), letting selective seals feed on it
                             # instead of cropping herring to extinction. Sediment-burying =>
                             # survey catches a tiny fraction of true stock, so a large factor
                             # is defensible. TUNE: raise if seals still crash herring/capelin;
                             # lower if sand lance over-dominates or will not sustain.
  `Capelin`          = 200)  # availability deficit (pelagic / off-bottom)
for (sp in names(forage_catchability_mult))
  biomass_obs[[sp]] <- biomass_obs[[sp]] * forage_catchability_mult[[sp]]


library(reshape2)
#Aggregate observed biomass to mean biomass
biomass_obs_sub <- subset(biomass_obs, Year >= 1970 & Year <= 2024)
biomass_ts <- reshape2::melt(biomass_obs_sub, id.vars = 1)
names(biomass_ts)<-c("Year","Species","Biomass")

biomass_ts <- biomass_ts|> rename(Biomass_Obs = Biomass)

```

# biomass_plot by species
```{r}
library(ggpubr)   # provides theme_pubr()
# ---- Species labels -----------------------------------------------------------
# Display names, in the SAME ORDER as species_params(params)$species.
species_labels <- c(
  "Atlantic Cod", "Haddock", "White Hake", "Red Hake", "Silver Hake", "Pollock",
  "Redfish Unseparated", "American Plaice", "Yellowtail Flounder", "Witch Flounder",
  "Atlantic Herring", "Capelin", "Thorny Skate", "Winter Skate", "Spiny Dogfish",
  "Monkfish", "Sand Lance", "Longhorn Sculpin", "Atlantic Halibut")

sp_names <- as.character(species_params(params)$species)
stopifnot("species_labels must have one entry per species in params" =
            length(species_labels) == length(sp_names))
stopifnot("biomass_ts species names do not match params species names" =
            all(as.character(biomass_ts$Species) %in% sp_names))

# Look up by NAME rather than renaming factor levels by position
label_map <- setNames(species_labels, sp_names)

# Facet order: the order listed above, or small -> large maximum body weight
order_by_size <- FALSE
facet_levels <- if (order_by_size) {
  species_labels[order(species_params(params)$w_max)]
} else {
  species_labels
}

# ---- Observations -------------------------------------------------------------
obs <- biomass_ts |>
  transmute(Species = factor(unname(label_map[as.character(Species)]), levels = facet_levels),
            Year,
            Biomass = Biomass_Obs) |>
  filter(Biomass > 0)

# ---- Simulated biomass --------------------------------------------------------
# One data frame per ensemble member, stacked with a sim index
extract_biomass <- function(sims) {
  lapply(sims, function(x) {
    m <- reshape2::melt(getBiomass(x, min_w = species_params(params)$biomass_cutoff),
                        varnames = c("time", "Species"), value.name = "value")
    m$time    <- as.numeric(as.character(m$time))
    m$Species <- as.character(m$Species)
    m
  }) |>
    bind_rows(.id = "sim")
}

# Median and min/max envelope across ensemble members, per species and year
summarise_ensemble <- function(df, scenario) {
  df |>rename(Year = time) |> group_by(Species, Year) |>
    summarise(sim_mean  = median(value),sim_lower = min(value),sim_upper = max(value),
              .groups = "drop") |>mutate(Scenario = scenario)
}

scen_levels <- c("Counterfactual (without fishing)", "Factual (with fishing)")
scen_cols   <- c("Counterfactual (without fishing)" = "#4575B4",
                 "Factual (with fishing)"            = "#D73027")

# sims_with_fishing is the FACTUAL ensemble; sims_with_no_fishing the COUNTERFACTUAL
sim_df <- bind_rows(
  summarise_ensemble(extract_biomass(sims_with_fishing),    scen_levels[2]),
  summarise_ensemble(extract_biomass(sims_with_no_fishing), scen_levels[1])
) |>
  # show the simulations over the span of the observations; they are no longer
  # cut to observed years only, so the lines are continuous
  filter(Year >= 1961, Year <= 2010) |>
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = scen_levels),
         Species  = factor(unname(label_map[Species]), levels = facet_levels))

# ---- Plot ---------------------------------------------------------------------
biomass_plot <- ggplot(sim_df, aes(x = Year, colour = Scenario, fill = Scenario)) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower / 1e9, ymax = sim_upper / 1e9),
              alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sim_mean / 1e9)) +
  # observations drawn once, not once per scenario
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = Year, y = Biomass / 1e9),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1981, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
  # automatic accuracy: accuracy = 1 rounded small-species ticks to "0"
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4),
                     labels = scales::label_number()) +
  labs(y = "Biomass (kt)", x = "Year") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(face = "bold"),
```

# Total biomass across species.
```{r}

# Total biomass across species.
# extract_biomass(), obs, scen_levels, scen_cols, sims_with_fishing, sims_with_no_fishing

# ---- Simulated total ----------------------------------------------------------
# Sum across species WITHIN each ensemble member first, then take the median and
# min/max across members. (Summing the per-species medians/mins/maxes in sim_df
# would not give the median/min/max of the total.)
total_ensemble <- function(sims, scenario) {
  extract_biomass(sims) |>
    rename(Year = time) |>
    filter(Year >= min(obs$Year), Year <= max(obs$Year)) |>
    group_by(sim, Year) |>
    summarise(total = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(Year) |>
    summarise(sim_mean  = median(total),
              sim_lower = min(total),
              sim_upper = max(total),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(Scenario = scenario)
}

sim_total <- bind_rows(
  total_ensemble(sims_with_fishing,    scen_levels[2]),
  total_ensemble(sims_with_no_fishing, scen_levels[1])
) |>
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = scen_levels))

# ---- Observed total -----------------------------------------------------------
obs_total <- obs |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = sum(Biomass), n_species = n_distinct(Species), .groups = "drop")

# A total is only comparable across years if the same species are present each year
print(table(obs_total$n_species))

# ---- Plot ---------------------------------------------------------------------
total_plot <- ggplot(sim_total, aes(x = Year, colour = Scenario, fill = Scenario)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower / 1e9, ymax = sim_upper / 1e9),
              alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sim_mean / 1e9)) +
  geom_point(data = obs_total, aes(x = Year, y = Biomass / 1e9),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1981, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number()) +
  labs(y = "Total biomass (kt)", x = "Year") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border    = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8))
```

Figure for CATCHES 
```{r}
# Figure for CATCHES
# Needs: sims_with_fishing, label_map, library(ggpubr)
# The counterfactual (no fishing) has zero catch by construction, so it is built
# as zeros from the factual table rather than extracted from sims_with_no_fishing
# (plotYieldGear returns no rows for it, which caused the "0, 1 rows" error).

# read in observed catch data
yield_ts <- readRDS("Ess_Fishmip_data/yield_ts.RDS")
yield_ts <- yield_ts |> rename(Yield_Obs = Yield) |>
  filter(!Species %in% c("Sand Lance", "Capelin", "Longhorn Sculpin")) |>
  # names -> display labels (harmless if they already are display labels)
  mutate(Species = as.character(Species),
         Species = ifelse(Species %in% names(label_map), label_map[Species], Species))

# ============================================================
# Function to extract catches from a simulation
# ============================================================
trimYield <- function(sim) {
  plotYieldGear(sim, return_data = TRUE) |>
    filter(!grepl("seal", Gear, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>   # seals are not fishery catch
    filter(!Species %in% c("Sand Lance", "Capelin", "Longhorn Sculpin")) |>
    group_by(Year, Species) |>
    summarise(Yield = sum(Yield), .groups = "drop")
}

# ============================================================
# Extract catches from the factual simulations
# ============================================================
sim_catches2 <- lapply(sims_with_fishing, trimYield)
for (i in seq_along(sim_catches2)) sim_catches2[[i]]$sim <- i
df_sim_catch2 <- do.call(rbind, sim_catches2)

# same names as the observations, and only the years we have observations for
df_sim_catch2 <- df_sim_catch2 |>
  mutate(Species = as.character(Species),
         Species = ifelse(Species %in% names(label_map), label_map[Species], Species)) |>
  filter(Year >= min(yield_ts$Year), Year <= max(yield_ts$Year))

# Stop here with a clear message if nothing came through
print(nrow(df_sim_catch2))
stopifnot("factual catch table is empty: check gear names and years" = nrow(df_sim_catch2) > 0)

# ============================================================
# Factual summaries
# ============================================================
sim_mean2_c  <- df_sim_catch2 |> group_by(Species, Year) |>
                summarise(Yield = median(Yield), .groups = "drop")
sim_lower2_c <- df_sim_catch2 |> group_by(Species, Year) |>
                summarise(Yield = min(Yield), .groups = "drop")
sim_upper2_c <- df_sim_catch2 |> group_by(Species, Year) |>
                summarise(Yield = max(Yield), .groups = "drop")

# ============================================================
# Create scenario data frames
# ============================================================
sim2_c <- data.frame(
  Species   = sim_mean2_c$Species,
  Year      = sim_mean2_c$Year,
  sim_mean  = sim_mean2_c$Yield,
  sim_lower = sim_lower2_c$Yield,
  sim_upper = sim_upper2_c$Yield,
  scen      = "Factual (with fishing)")

# No fishing = no catch: zero in every species and year
sim1_c <- sim2_c
sim1_c$sim_mean  <- 0
sim1_c$sim_lower <- 0
sim1_c$sim_upper <- 0
sim1_c$scen      <- "Counterfactual (without fishing)"

# ============================================================
# Combine scenarios
# ============================================================
time_series_c <- rbind(sim1_c, sim2_c)

# Species in the plot, in the order shown
species_order <- c("Atlantic Cod", "Haddock", "White Hake", "Red Hake", "Silver Hake",
                   "Pollock", "Redfish Unseparated", "American Plaice",
                   "Yellowtail Flounder", "Witch Flounder", "Atlantic Herring",
                   "Thorny Skate", "Winter Skate", "Spiny Dogfish", "Monkfish",
                   "Atlantic Halibut")

time_series_c$Species <- factor(time_series_c$Species, levels = species_order)
time_series_c$scen    <- factor(time_series_c$scen,
                                levels = c("Counterfactual (without fishing)",
                                           "Factual (with fishing)"))
yield_obs <- yield_ts |> filter(Yield_Obs > 0)
yield_obs$Species <- factor(yield_obs$Species, levels = species_order)

# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================
yield_plot <- ggplot(time_series_c,
    aes(x = Year, colour = scen, fill = scen)) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4,
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 14)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower/1e9, ymax = sim_upper/1e9), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sim_mean/1e9)) +

             inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 0.3) +

  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL,
    values = c("Counterfactual (without fishing)" = "#4575B4",
               "Factual (with fishing)"            = "#D73027")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +

                     labels = scales::label_number()) +
  labs(y = "Catches (kt)", x = "Year") +
```

## Annual biomass and catch for every simulation (computed once)
```{r annual-tables}
# For each scenario and each simulation: annual mean (over months) of biomass
# above each species' cutoff, and of yield summed over fishing gears, per species.
# Everything below is built from these two tables.
bio_list <- list()
yld_list <- list()

for (sc in scen_levels) {
  for (k in seq_along(scen_list[[sc]])) {
    s <- scen_list[[sc]][[k]]
    if (is.null(s)) next

    # biomass, g: time x species -> annual mean, year x species
    b  <- getBiomass(s, min_w = species_params(s@params)$biomass_cutoff)
    tb <- floor(as.numeric(rownames(b)))
    ba <- rowsum(b, tb) / as.vector(table(tb))
    ba <- ba[rownames(ba) %in% years_out, , drop = FALSE]
    bio_list[[length(bio_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      scen = sc, sim = k,
      Year = as.numeric(rownames(ba))[row(ba)],
      Species = colnames(ba)[col(ba)],
      value = as.vector(ba))

    # yield, g/year: time x gear x species -> sum fishing gears -> annual mean
    y  <- getYieldGear(s)
    y  <- apply(y[, fishing_gears, , drop = FALSE], c(1, 3), sum)   # time x species
    ty <- floor(as.numeric(rownames(y)))
    ya <- rowsum(y, ty) / as.vector(table(ty))
    ya <- ya[rownames(ya) %in% years_out, , drop = FALSE]
    yld_list[[length(yld_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      scen = sc, sim = k,
      Year = as.numeric(rownames(ya))[row(ya)],
      Species = colnames(ya)[col(ya)],
      value = as.vector(ya))
  }
}

bio_ann <- bind_rows(bio_list)
yld_ann <- bind_rows(yld_list)
rm(bio_list, yld_list)

# members per scenario that made it through
bio_ann |> distinct(scen, sim) |> count(scen)
```

## 1. Total consumer biomass (tcb)
```{r tcb}
# Optional: drop species from the survey total (e.g. "Sand Lance", whose survey
# estimates look implausibly large). Leave as character(0) to keep everything.
obs_exclude <- character(0)

# sum species within each sim, then median / min / max across sims (g -> g m-2)
tcb <- bio_ann |>
  group_by(scen, sim, Year) |>
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(scen, Year) |>
  summarise(sim_median = median(value), sim_lower = min(value),
            sim_upper = max(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(sim_median, sim_lower, sim_upper), ~ .x / area_m2),
         scen = factor(scen, levels = scen_levels))

# observed survey total (assumes grams)
obs_tcb <- biomass_ts |>
  filter(!Species %in% obs_exclude) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(Biomass = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(Biomass > 0, Year %in% years_out) |>
  transmute(Year, value = Biomass / area_m2)

# export one file per scenario
for (sc in scen_levels) {
  out <- tcb |> filter(scen == sc)
  out <- data.frame(Year = out$Year, "tcb.gm-2" = out$sim_median, check.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(out, paste0(fish_prefix[sc], scen_tag[sc], "_15arcmin_tcb_ESS_Yearly_1961_2010.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}

ggplot(tcb, aes(x = Year, colour = scen, fill = scen)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sim_median), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = obs_tcb, aes(x = Year, y = value, shape = "Survey"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = 16) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression("Total consumer biomass density (g m"^-2*")"),
       title = "Simulated total consumer biomass vs observations, 1961-2010") +
  theme_bw()

# scale check on the factual run: ~0 = consistent; ~+/-3 or 6 = units problem
chk <- inner_join(tcb |> filter(scen == "With fishing") |> select(Year, sim = sim_median),
                  obs_tcb |> select(Year, obs = value), by = "Year")
message("tcb log10(median obs/sim) = ",
        round(log10(median(chk$obs / chk$sim, na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
        "  (", nrow(chk), " overlapping years)")
```

## 2. Total consumer biomass in log10 weight bins (tcblog10)
```{r tcblog10}
# NOTE: the first bin starts at log10(w) = 0 (1 g), so weight classes below 1 g
# are excluded. The bins therefore sum to slightly less than tcb. Change the
# first edge to -Inf (and add a bin name) if you want to include them.
bin_edges <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, Inf)   # log10(g)
bin_names <- c("1to10g.gm-2", "10to100g.gm-2", "100gto1kg.gm-2",
               "1to10kg.gm-2", "10to100kg.gm-2", "GT100kg.gm-2")

res_tcblog10 <- list()
for (sc in scen_levels) {
  sim  <- scen_list[[sc]][[1]]                    # one simulation
  w    <- sim@params@w
  dw   <- sim@params@dw
  n    <- N(sim)                                  # time x species x weight
  tt   <- as.numeric(dimnames(n)[[1]])
  keep <- floor(tt) %in% years_out

  bin   <- cut(log10(w), bin_edges, labels = bin_names, right = FALSE)
  n_all <- apply(n[keep, , , drop = FALSE], c(1, 3), sum)   # sum species -> time x weight
  bio_w <- sweep(n_all, 2, w * dw, "*")                     # grams per weight class

  out <- sapply(bin_names, function(b)
    rowSums(bio_w[, which(bin == b), drop = FALSE]) / area_m2)   # g m-2, time x bin

  res_tcblog10[[sc]] <- data.frame(Year = tt[keep], out, check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
  print(c(sc, nrow(res_tcblog10[[sc]])))          # expect 600 (monthly)

  write.csv(res_tcblog10[[sc]],
            paste0(fish_prefix[sc], scen_tag[sc], "_15arcmin_tcblog10_ESS_Yearly_1961_2010.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## 5. Total catch (tc)

Without fishing every gear has zero effort, so the "Without fishing" catch is
zero by construction; it is exported and plotted for completeness.
```{r tc}
tc <- yld_ann |>
  group_by(scen, sim, Year) |>
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(scen, Year) |>
  summarise(sim_median = median(value), sim_lower = min(value),
            sim_upper = max(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(sim_median, sim_lower, sim_upper), ~ .x / area_m2),
         scen = factor(scen, levels = scen_levels))

for (sc in scen_levels) {
  out <- tc |> filter(scen == sc)
  out <- data.frame(Year = out$Year, "tc.gm-2" = out$sim_median, check.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(out, paste0(fish_prefix[sc], scen_tag[sc], "_15arcmin_tc_ESS_Yearly_1961_2010.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

### Observed catch
```{r tc-obs}
# read in observed catch data
yield_ts <- readRDS(file.path("Ess_Fishmip_data", "yield_ts.RDS")) |>
  rename(Yield_Obs = Yield) |>
  filter(!Species %in% c("Sand Lance", "Capelin", "Longhorn Sculpin")) |>
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = unique(Species))) |>
  arrange(match(Species, levels(Species)), Year)

# CHECK THE UNITS: the values (~1e10-1e11) look like grams already.
# 1 = data already in grams; 1e6 = data in tonnes; 1e3 = data in kg.
# The scale check at the bottom should give a value near 0 when this is right
# (about 6 means you need 1e6, about 3 means you need 1e3).
catch_to_g <- 1

obs_tc <- yield_ts |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(Catch = sum(Yield_Obs, na.rm = TRUE) * catch_to_g, .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(Year %in% years_out) |>
  transmute(Year, value = Catch / area_m2)

ggplot(tc, aes(x = Year, colour = scen, fill = scen)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = sim_median), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = obs_tc, aes(x = Year, y = value, shape = "Observed"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = 16) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression("Total catch (g m"^-2*" year"^-1*")"),
       title = "Simulated total catch vs observations") +
  theme_bw()

chk <- inner_join(tc |> filter(scen == "With fishing") |> select(Year, sim = sim_median),
                  obs_tc |> select(Year, obs = value), by = "Year")
message("tc log10(median obs/sim) = ",
        round(log10(median(chk$obs / chk$sim, na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
        "  (", nrow(chk), " overlapping years)")
```

## 6. Catch in log10 weight bins (tclog10)
```{r tclog10}
# Fishing mortality summed over the fishing gears only (seal gear excluded),
# so it matches the yield used everywhere else. Note this holds a
# time x gear x species x weight array for one sim at a time.
res_tclog10 <- list()
for (sc in scen_levels) {
  sim  <- scen_list[[sc]][[1]]
  w    <- sim@params@w
  dw   <- sim@params@dw
  n    <- N(sim)                                  # time x species x weight
  f    <- getFMortGear(sim)                       # time x gear x species x weight, 1/yr
  f    <- apply(f[, fishing_gears, , , drop = FALSE], c(1, 3, 4), sum)
  stopifnot(identical(dim(n), dim(f)))

  tt   <- as.numeric(dimnames(n)[[1]])
  keep <- floor(tt) %in% years_out

  catch <- n[keep, , , drop = FALSE] * f[keep, , , drop = FALSE]
  c_tw  <- apply(catch, c(1, 3), sum)             # sum species -> time x weight
  c_w   <- sweep(c_tw, 2, w * dw, "*")            # g/yr per weight class

  bin <- cut(log10(w), bin_edges, labels = bin_names, right = FALSE)
  out <- sapply(bin_names, function(b)
    rowSums(c_w[, which(bin == b), drop = FALSE]) / area_m2)   # g m-2 yr-1

  res_tclog10[[sc]] <- data.frame(Year = tt[keep], out, check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
  print(c(sc, nrow(res_tclog10[[sc]])))           # expect 600

  # No header and no Year column; row order is the month
  write.table(res_tclog10[[sc]][, -1],
              paste0(fish_prefix[sc], scen_tag[sc], "_15arcmin_tclog10_ESS_Yearly_1961_2010.csv"),
              sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
}
```

## 8. Size-class groups (by maximum length, L_inf)
```{r size-groups}
sp <- params@species_params
sp$l_max <- (sp$w_max / sp$a)^(1 / sp$b)     # cm, from W = a L^b
stopifnot(!anyNA(sp$l_max))
is_pel <- sp$species %in% pelagic

groups <- list(
  pel_small  = sp$species[ is_pel & sp$l_max <  30],
  pel_medium = sp$species[ is_pel & sp$l_max >= 30 & sp$l_max < 90],
  pel_large  = sp$species[ is_pel & sp$l_max >= 90],
  dem_small  = sp$species[!is_pel & sp$l_max <  30],
  dem_medium = sp$species[!is_pel & sp$l_max >= 30 & sp$l_max < 90],
  dem_large  = sp$species[!is_pel & sp$l_max >= 90]
)
print(groups)                                          # eyeball the assignments
stopifnot(length(unlist(groups)) == nrow(sp))          # every species in exactly one group

classes <- data.frame(
  code  = c("p30cm", "p30to90cm", "p90cm", "d30cm", "d30to90cm", "d90cm"),
  group = c("pel_small", "pel_medium", "pel_large",
            "dem_small", "dem_medium", "dem_large"),
  title = c("small pelagics (L_inf < 30 cm)",
            "medium pelagics (L_inf 30-90 cm)",
            "large pelagics (L_inf >= 90 cm)",
            "small demersals (L_inf < 30 cm)",
            "medium demersals (L_inf 30-90 cm)",
            "large demersals (L_inf >= 90 cm)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

### Biomass density by size class (bp30cm ... bd90cm)
```{r size-biomass}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(classes))) {
  code <- classes$code[i]
  spp  <- groups[[classes$group[i]]]

  if (length(spp) == 0) {
    message("Group '", classes$group[i], "' has no species: b", code,
            " will be written as zeros.")
    res <- expand.grid(scen = scen_levels, Year = years_out, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
      mutate(sim_median = 0, sim_lower = 0, sim_upper = 0,
             scen = factor(scen, levels = scen_levels))
  } else {
    res <- bio_ann |>
      filter(Species %in% spp) |>
      group_by(scen, sim, Year) |>
      summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
      group_by(scen, Year) |>
      summarise(sim_median = median(value), sim_lower = min(value),
                sim_upper = max(value), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(across(c(sim_median, sim_lower, sim_upper), ~ .x / area_m2),
             scen = factor(scen, levels = scen_levels))
  }

  for (sc in scen_levels) {
    out <- res |> filter(scen == sc)
    out <- data.frame(Year = out$Year, out$sim_median)
    names(out) <- c("Year", paste0("b", code, ".gm-2"))
    write.csv(out, paste0(fish_prefix[sc], scen_tag[sc], "_15arcmin_b", code,
                          "_ESS_Yearly_1961_2010.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  # observed: years where all species in the class have non-zero survey values
  obs <- NULL
  if (length(spp) > 0) {
    obs <- biomass_ts |>
      filter(Species %in% spp) |>
      mutate(Biomass = ifelse(Biomass == 0, NA, Biomass)) |>
      group_by(Year) |>
      summarise(n_sp = sum(!is.na(Biomass)),
                Biomass = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      filter(n_sp >= length(spp), Year %in% years_out) |>
      transmute(Year, value = Biomass / area_m2)
  }

  p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = Year, colour = scen, fill = scen)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(aes(y = sim_median), linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = scen_cols) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = expression("Biomass density (g m"^-2*")"),
         title = paste("Simulated biomass of", classes$title[i],
                       "vs observations, 1961-2010")) +
    theme_bw()
  if (!is.null(obs) && nrow(obs) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = Year, y = value, shape = "Survey"),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 1.8) +
      scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = 16)

    chk <- inner_join(res |> filter(scen == "With fishing") |> select(Year, sim = sim_median),
                      obs |> select(Year, obs = value), by = "Year")
    message("b", code, " log10(median obs/sim) = ",
            round(log10(median(chk$obs / chk$sim, na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
            "  (", nrow(chk), " overlapping years)")
  }
  print(p)
}
```

```{r size-catch}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(classes))) {

  spp  <- groups[[classes$group[i]]]

  if (length(spp) == 0) {
    message("Group '", classes$group[i], "' has no species: c", code,

             scen = factor(scen, levels = scen_levels))
  } else {
    res <- yld_ann |>
      filter(Species %in% spp) |>
      group_by(scen, sim, Year) |>
      summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
      group_by(scen, Year) |>
      summarise(sim_median = median(value), sim_lower = min(value),
                sim_upper = max(value), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(across(c(sim_median, sim_lower, sim_upper), ~ .x / area_m2),
             scen = factor(scen, levels = scen_levels))
  }

  for (sc in scen_levels) {

    out <- data.frame(Year = out$Year, out$sim_median)

                          "_ESS_Yearly_1961_2010.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  # observed: only works if catch_ts columns are named exactly like the model species
  obs <- NULL
  cols <- intersect(spp, setdiff(names(catch_ts), "Year"))
  if (length(cols) < length(spp))
    message("Catch data has no column for: ", paste(setdiff(spp, cols), collapse = ", "))
  if (length(cols) > 0) {
    obs <- catch_ts |>
      mutate(Catch = rowSums(across(all_of(cols)), na.rm = TRUE) * catch_to_g) |>
      filter(Year %in% years_out) |>
      transmute(Year, value = Catch / area_m2)
  }

  p <- ggplot(res, aes(x = Year, colour = scen, fill = scen)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = sim_lower, ymax = sim_upper), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(aes(y = sim_median), linewidth = 0.8) +

                       "vs observations, 1961-2010")) +
    theme_bw()
  if (!is.null(obs) && nrow(obs) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = Year, y = value, shape = "Survey"),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", size = 1.8) +

    chk <- inner_join(res |> filter(scen == "With fishing") |> select(Year, sim = sim_median),

    message("c", code, " log10(median obs/sim) = ",
            round(log10(median(chk$obs / chk$sim, na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
            "  (", nrow(chk), " overlapping years)")
  }

}
```
